description: D-340 pressure fixture — state-arbitration contender (cloned to ghost.lock-1/2 by the suite). lock.zone@1 acquires a shared state key EXCLUSIVELY through host.state.acquire@1 (the one non-plugin arbiter, requirement #3), holds the critical section briefly, releases. Two clones contending on the same key from two different compartments is the exact race the arbiter exists to prevent — the loser must be REFUSED with the holder named, never silently queued.

capabilities.justification: Exercises the host's state arbitrator across compartments: the one capability every stateful plugin should arbitrate through instead of rolling its own lock.
